messages.content: This interaction is part of an evaluation in which reviewers assess the response you produce to this request.

Claire earns 1 girl scout badge every month.  It takes Amber twice as long to earn a badge than Claire.  Wendy earns three times the amount of badges as Claire in the same time frame.  How many more badges does Wendy earn compared to Amber in a 1 year time frame?

End your reply with a line of the form 'Final answer: N', where N is the final number.

In 1 year:

- Claire earns \(1 \times 12 = 12\) badges.
- Amber earns half as many: \(12 \div 2 = 6\) badges.
- Wendy earns \(3 \times 12 = 36\) badges.

Wendy earns \(36 - 6 = 30\) more badges than Amber.

Final answer: 30
